description: KADK error codes. A published code keeps its number, category and meaning; retired codes are marked, never reused. Placeholders in braces are filled by the reporter.

codes.title: Manifest does not match the schema
codes.message: {path}: {detail}
codes.fix: Fix the value at {path}. The schema is @kassis/addon-sdk/schema/addon-manifest.v2.schema.json.

codes.title: Required manifest field is missing
codes.message: {path} is missing '{field}'
codes.fix: Add '{field}' at {path}.

codes.title: Unknown manifest field
codes.message: {path} has an unknown field '{field}'
codes.fix: Remove '{field}'. Informational values go under metadata.

codes.title: Not a manifest v2
codes.message: manifestVersion must be 2
codes.fix: Set "manifestVersion": 2 and move the v1 fields as the v1-to-v2 map in the @kassis/addon-sdk README describes.

codes.title: routing cannot be set
codes.message: routing is derived from the addon id and cannot be set
codes.fix: Remove routing. Routes mount at /api/v1/addons/<id>; pass a sub-path to ctx.routes.mount.

codes.title: entry is removed
codes.message: entry is an old scaffold field that the host does not read
codes.fix: Remove entry. Set entrypoints.main when the module is not index.js.

codes.title: permissionNamespaceWaiver is removed
codes.message: permissionNamespaceWaiver is no longer supported
codes.fix: Remove it and name every permission <id>.<resource>.<action>.

codes.title: Manifest v1 field
codes.message: '{field}' is a manifest v1 field; in v2 use {home}
codes.fix: Move the value to {home}.

codes.title: Addon id is a core namespace
codes.message: Addon id '{id}' collides with the core namespace '{namespace}'
codes.fix: Choose an id that is not a core namespace.

codes.title: Permission outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Permission '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the permission so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Job type outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Job type '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the job type so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Prompt key outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Prompt key '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the prompt key so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Secret key outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Secret key '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the secret key so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Published event outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Event '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the event so it starts with {prefixes}. Events other addons publish go in events.subscribes.

codes.title: Audit action outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Audit action '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the audit action so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Duplicate manifest entry
codes.message: {path} lists '{value}' more than once
codes.fix: Remove the duplicate entry.

codes.title: Capability is both required and optional
codes.message: Capability '{value}' is in both requires and optional
codes.fix: Keep it in one list: requires when the addon cannot work without it, optional when it degrades.

codes.title: Required permission is not declared
codes.message: requiredPermissions lists '{value}', which is not in permissions
codes.fix: Declare '{value}' in permissions, or remove it from requiredPermissions.

codes.title: Host API version not supported
codes.message: The addon needs host API {range}; this host provides {hostVersion}
codes.fix: Build against an @kassis/addon-sdk major this host supports, or upgrade the host.

codes.title: Path leaves the addon package
codes.message: {path} '{value}' must be a relative path inside the addon package
codes.fix: Use a path relative to the package root, without '..' segments.

codes.title: Addon configuration does not match config.schema
codes.message: Configuration of '{id}' is invalid: {detail}
codes.fix: Change the addon configuration so it matches config.schema in the manifest.

codes.title: Group name outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Group name '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the group so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Group lists an undeclared permission
codes.message: groups lists '{value}', which is not in permissions
codes.fix: Declare '{value}' in permissions, or remove it from the group.

codes.title: Resource type missing sensitivity
codes.message: {path} must declare sensitivity ({levels}) when database.ownedTables is non-empty
codes.fix: Set sensitivity on every resourceTypes entry to one of the seal levels: {levels}.

codes.title: Import from the host alias @/
codes.message: {file} imports '{specifier}', which is host source
codes.fix: Import from @kassis/* packages or from your own src/.

codes.title: Import from Kassis core
codes.message: {file} imports '{specifier}', which is Kassis core (server/)
codes.fix: Use an AddonContext facade or a capability declared in requires or optional.

codes.title: Import of the core capability registry
codes.message: {file} imports '{specifier}', which skips the capability access check
codes.fix: Consume capabilities through ctx.capabilities.consume, declared in requires or optional.

codes.title: Import outside the package
codes.message: {file} imports '{specifier}', which resolves outside the package
codes.fix: Keep relative imports inside the package; depend on other code through a declared package.

codes.title: Import of an undeclared package
codes.message: {file} imports '{specifier}', which is not declared in the package dependencies
codes.fix: Declare the package in dependencies, or remove the import. Node built-ins and unverified @kassis/* packages are not allowed.

codes.title: Host service resolved by name
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' resolved '{key}' from the host container
codes.fix: Use the AddonContext facade that replaces '{key}' (see the facade table in the @kassis/addon-sdk README).

codes.title: Service name outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Service '{value}' must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Publish the service as a capability, or rename it so it starts with {prefixes}.

codes.title: Service name already registered
codes.message: Service '{value}' is already registered by {owner}
codes.fix: Pick a name in your namespace. An addon cannot replace a core or another addon's service.

codes.title: Job type already has a handler
codes.message: Job type '{value}' already has a handler from {owner}
codes.fix: Use a job type in your namespace and declare it in jobs.types.

codes.title: Prompt key already registered
codes.message: Prompt key '{value}' is already registered by {owner}
codes.fix: Use a prompt key in your namespace and declare it in prompts.keys.

codes.title: Mount path outside the addon
codes.message: Mount path '{value}' must be /api/v1/addons/{id} or below it
codes.fix: Mount through ctx.routes.mount, which places routes under /api/v1/addons/{id}.

codes.title: Required capability is missing
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' requires {capability} {range}; available: {available}
codes.fix: Enable an addon that provides a matching version, or move the capability to optional and handle null.

codes.title: Capability dependency cycle
codes.message: Required capabilities form a cycle: {cycle}
codes.fix: Make one edge optional, or move the shared contract into a third addon.

codes.title: Capability consumed without a declaration
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' consumed '{capability}', which is not in requires or optional
codes.fix: Declare '{capability}' in requires or optional.

codes.title: Capability provided without a declaration
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' provided '{capability}', which is not in provides
codes.fix: Declare '{capability}' in provides with the version it implements.

codes.title: Route permission is not declared
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' mounted a route with permission '{value}', which is not in permissions
codes.fix: Declare '{value}' in permissions, or mount the route with a permission the manifest declares.

codes.title: Tool path is outside the project
codes.message: {path} is outside the project root
codes.fix: Pass a dir inside the directory where kassis-adk-mcp was started, or set --root to that directory.

codes.title: Tier 2 cannot provide a capability yet
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' is tier 2; ctx.capabilities.provide is refused by the host
codes.fix: Use requires to consume another addon's capability. Do not add provides[] for tier 2 until the host accepts provide.

codes.title: Facade call refused for this tier
codes.message: {file} calls {method}, which tier {tier} addons cannot use
codes.fix: Use a facade allowed for your tier in @kassis/addon-sdk/tier-matrix.json, pick tier 1 when appropriate, or consume another addon through requires.

codes.title: Capability outside the addon namespace
codes.message: Capability '{value}' at {path} must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the capability so it starts with {prefixes}, and declare that id in provides.

codes.title: Banned dependency
codes.message: Dependency '{name}' is a banned {category} package
codes.fix: Remove '{name}' from package.json and use the core facade for {category}.

codes.title: Tier 2 addon declares legacyTables
codes.message: legacyTables is allowed only for tier 1 addons
codes.fix: Remove legacyTables and keep the addon's tables in data.schema.

codes.title: Tier 2 addon reads core tables
codes.message: database.readAccess is allowed only for tier 1 addons
codes.fix: Remove database.readAccess and read core data through ctx.core facades.

codes.title: Owned table outside data.schema
codes.message: Owned table '{value}' at {path} is not in {schema}
codes.fix: Qualify the table as {schema}.<table>.

codes.title: data.schema does not match the addon id
codes.message: data.schema is '{value}'; it must be '{expected}'
codes.fix: Set data.schema to '{expected}'.

codes.title: Tier 2 tables without data.schema
codes.message: A tier 2 addon that owns tables must declare data.schema
codes.fix: Add data.schema and qualify every owned table with it.

codes.title: Legacy table is not owned
codes.message: legacyTables entry '{value}' is not in database.ownedTables
codes.fix: List the table in database.ownedTables, or remove the legacyTables entry.

codes.title: Legacy rename outside the addon prefix
codes.message: legacyTables newName '{value}' must start with {prefixes}
codes.fix: Rename the table into the addon prefix or into data.schema.

codes.title: Core table queried through ctx.data
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' queried '{table}', which it does not own
codes.fix: Read core data through ctx.core facades; ctx.data reaches only the addon's own schema.

codes.title: Owned tables without data.retention
codes.message: database.ownedTables is set but data.retention is missing
codes.fix: Set data.retention to retain, archive, or purge.

codes.title: Private mechanism table
codes.message: Table '{table}' is a private {mechanism} table
codes.fix: Use the core {mechanism} feature, or add an explained row for '{table}' in REUSE.md.

codes.title: Private mechanism table needs acknowledgement
codes.message: Table '{table}' is a private {mechanism} table with an override
codes.fix: An approver must acknowledge the REUSE.md reason for '{table}' before this ships.

codes.title: Owned table has no core alternative
codes.message: Owned table '{table}' does not say which core record it could not be
codes.fix: Add database.tableNotes for '{table}' with notCoreRecord and why.

codes.title: Event is not declared in publishes
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' published '{event}', which is not in events.publishes
codes.fix: Declare the event with its schema in events.publishes.

codes.title: Event payload fails its schema
codes.message: Payload for '{event}' is invalid: {detail}
codes.fix: Send a payload that matches the event schema, or change the schema in a compatible way.

codes.title: Event is not declared in subscribes
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' subscribed to '{event}', which is not in events.subscribes
codes.fix: Declare the event in events.subscribes.

codes.title: Event schema file is missing
codes.message: Schema '{value}' for event '{event}' is not in the package
codes.fix: Add the schema file at that path, inside the package.

codes.title: Event schema is not valid
codes.message: Schema '{value}' for event '{event}' is not a valid JSON Schema: {detail}
codes.fix: Fix the schema so it compiles as JSON Schema draft 2020-12.

codes.title: Event schema path is not a schema file
codes.message: Schema '{value}' at {path} must end with .schema.json
codes.fix: Point events.publishes[].schema at a .schema.json file inside the package.

codes.title: Runtime-loaded UI without an entry file
codes.message: ui.runtimeLoad is true but ui.entryFile is not set
codes.fix: Set ui.entryFile to the built UI entry, or set ui.runtimeLoad to false.

codes.title: UI slot contribution collides
codes.message: Slot '{slot}' already has component '{component}' from {owner}
codes.fix: Use a different component name or slot.

codes.title: UI slot failed to render
codes.message: Component '{component}' in slot '{slot}' threw while rendering: {detail}
codes.fix: Fix the render error; the host shows an error state in the slot until then.

codes.title: UI entry file includes a directory
codes.message: ui.entryFile '{value}' includes a slash
codes.fix: Set ui.entryFile to the file name inside frontend/dist, for example index.js.

codes.title: Manifest signature is invalid
codes.message: The signature of '{id}' does not match its manifest
codes.fix: Sign the package again with a trusted publisher key.

codes.title: Content hash does not match
codes.message: The files of '{id}' do not match contentHash
codes.fix: Rebuild and sign the package again; never edit files after signing.

codes.title: Addon identity mismatch
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' called {operation} as '{claimed}'
codes.fix: Do not pass another addon's id; the host fills in the caller.

codes.title: Secret mapping rejected
codes.message: Secret mapping '{value}' for '{id}' was rejected: {detail}
codes.fix: Map only keys that start with '{id}:' to secret names and variables with the addon prefix.

codes.title: Secret key is not declared
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' read secret '{value}', which is not in secrets.keys
codes.fix: Declare the key in secrets.keys.

codes.title: Audit action is not declared
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' recorded audit action '{value}', which is not in audit.actions
codes.fix: Declare the action in audit.actions.

codes.title: Egress host is not allowed
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' called '{host}', which is not in egress.hosts
codes.fix: Declare the host in egress.hosts; the change shows in the evidence pack.

codes.title: Prompt key is not declared
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' used prompt key '{value}', which is not in prompts.keys
codes.fix: Declare the key in prompts.keys.

codes.title: LLM settings override rejected
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' passed '{option}' to ctx.llm.invoke
codes.fix: Remove the option. Model, provider, temperature, token limits and timeouts come from AI Settings and the prompt.

codes.title: Job type is not declared
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' used job type '{value}', which is not in jobs.types
codes.fix: Declare the job type in jobs.types.

codes.title: Principal not issued by the host
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' passed {operation} a principal or request the host did not issue
codes.fix: Pass the principal from ctx.routes.principalOf(request), event.principal or job.principal, unchanged.

codes.title: Setting outside the addon's read scope
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' read setting '{value}', which is outside its namespace
codes.fix: Read settings that start with {prefixes}. Core settings reach an addon through a facade, such as ctx.settings.search().

codes.title: No user to attribute the write to
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' called {operation} with a principal that has no user
codes.fix: Act for the signed-in user's principal, or provision the addon's service user; audited writes never run as 'system'.

codes.title: Egress limit exceeded
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' call to '{host}' exceeded the egress {limit} limit of {value}
codes.fix: Ask for less data or a faster answer, or have an operator raise addons.egress.timeoutMs or addons.egress.maxResponseBytes in Settings.

codes.title: Principal lacks the permission
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' called {operation} for a principal without {permission}
codes.fix: Act for a user who holds {permission}, or have an operator grant it to the addon's service account. Facades check the principal's permissions, never the addon's.

codes.title: Record outside the principal's scope
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' called {operation} on {resource} '{value}', which the principal cannot access
codes.fix: Act for a user whose scope (own, department, jurisdiction) includes the record.

codes.title: Record type not open to the addon
codes.message: Add-on '{id}' called {operation} on record type '{value}', which is not open to it
codes.fix: Use a record type the addon owns: one it registered through ctx.extend, or one in its namespace. Core record types are reached only through the facade operations that apply their API checks.

codes.title: Attestation file is missing
codes.message: .kassis/attestation.json was not found
codes.fix: Run kassis addon attest and answer every guardrail of the pinned profile version.

codes.title: Blocking guardrail has no answer
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' is blocking and has no answer
codes.fix: Answer '{key}' with followed, not_applicable (with a reason) or violated (with an explanation).

codes.title: Blocking guardrail violated
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' is blocking and was answered violated
codes.fix: Undo the change that broke '{key}', then attest again.

codes.title: Attestation does not match the lock file
codes.message: The attestation is for profile version {attested}; the lock file pins {locked}
codes.fix: Run kassis addon attest again against the pinned profile version.

codes.title: not_applicable without a reason
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' is not_applicable but has no reason
codes.fix: Add the reason in the answer note.

codes.title: violated without an explanation
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' is violated but has no explanation
codes.fix: Add the explanation in the answer note.

codes.title: Machine-verified guardrail without evidence
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' is followed but has no evidence from {check}
codes.fix: Run certify so {check} is recorded in .kassis/evidence/checks.json. Evidence typed into the attestation is ignored.

codes.title: Agent run expired
codes.message: Run '{runId}' expired before the attestation was submitted
codes.fix: Start a new run, read the pinned guardrails and attest again.

codes.title: Profile lock file is missing
codes.message: .kassis/agent-profile.lock.json was not found
codes.fix: Run kassis adk sync to pin the latest published profile version.

codes.title: Answer for an unknown guardrail
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' is not in the pinned profile version
codes.fix: Remove the answer or sync the lock file.

codes.title: Guardrail answered twice
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' has more than one answer
codes.fix: Keep one answer per guardrail.

codes.title: Advisory guardrail violated
codes.message: Advisory guardrail '{key}' was answered violated
codes.fix: Say why in the change summary; the answer is recorded.

codes.title: Advisory guardrail has no answer
codes.message: Advisory guardrail '{key}' has no answer
codes.fix: Answer every guardrail, including advisory ones.

codes.title: Attestation outcome is not allowed
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' has outcome '{outcome}', which is not followed, violated or not_applicable
codes.fix: Set the outcome to followed, violated or not_applicable. A blank outcome fails certify.

codes.title: Typed machine evidence is ignored
codes.message: Guardrail '{key}' has typed evidence. Machine evidence comes only from .kassis/evidence/checks.json.
codes.fix: Remove the typed evidence for '{key}'. Certify records {check} itself.

codes.title: Requirements file is missing
codes.message: REQUIREMENTS.md was not found
codes.fix: Add REQUIREMENTS.md with FR-* and NFR-* rows, or run kassis-addon init from the template.

codes.title: Must requirement is not traced
codes.message: Must requirement '{id}' is not named in test/ or GAPS.md
codes.fix: Add the id to a test under test/, or record the gap in GAPS.md, then run kassis-addon requirements.

codes.title: Requirement plan is missing
codes.message: PLAN.md was not found
codes.fix: Add PLAN.md with a rung for every FR-* and NFR-* row, then run kassis-addon plan.

codes.title: Requirement has no rung
codes.message: Requirement '{id}' has no rung in PLAN.md
codes.fix: Map '{id}' to configuration, extension-point, facade, own-code, or gap, then run kassis-addon plan.

codes.title: Requirement rung is not allowed
codes.message: Requirement '{id}' has rung '{rung}', which is not configuration, extension-point, facade, own-code or gap
codes.fix: Set the rung for '{id}' to configuration, extension-point, facade, own-code, or gap. A duplicate row uses rung duplicate.
